answer: A hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The signal counter is kept in thread and garden shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 130 aliases cost 183 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
